_comment: The RELEASE LANE: slow corpus / integration / determinism classes that leave the default gate (tools/agent/Invoke-Gate.ps1 -Gate, plain dotnet test) and run in tools/agent/Invoke-Gate.ps1 -ReleaseLane instead - always in the merge train (Merge-Train.ps1), the release preflight (New-Release.ps1) and CI's test job. This file is the ONE declared list: tools/ci/GateShards.psm1 reads it for both lanes' filters, DotCharter.Tests/TestEntryPoint.cs for a plain dotnet test, and Infrastructure/ReleaseLaneLintTests proves every test class runs in exactly one lane. Keys are the class's FullName (a nested class joins with +). seconds = measured summed case time of an idle gate run, only used to balance the lane's shards (refresh: Invoke-Gate.ps1 -ReleaseLane -UpdateShardWeights); why = what the class tests and why it is not a per-change check. Move a class here by what it TESTS (a slow end-to-end, corpus or determinism check of one subsystem), never to hide a flaky or slow unit test: fix those.

DotCharter.Tests.Ai.Search.ToneMatcherTe.why: A full 1000-render tone match seeded with the exact prior; integration of the whole search pipeline.
A full 1000-render match that recovers a hidden rig to within a tenth of every knob: the one test that fails if any search stage is wrong, and the slowest.

DotCharter.Tests.Analysis.AnalysisDeterm.why: Re-runs every DotCharter.Analysis pipeline over synthesized fixtures, in varied execution orders, and diffs the output: a repeatability guard. Only a change under DotCharter.Analysis can break it.

DotCharter.Tests.Audio.Dsp.RsToneConvers.why: Renders the reference DI through converted Rocksmith tones on the real native rig and holds the result to relational fidelity targets: an end-to-end calibration harness for the tone conversion.

DotCharter.Tests.Infrastructure.PublicSn.why: Runs Export-PublicSnapshot.ps1 end to end over fixture git repositories under pwsh. Only a change under tools/release or the export rename map can break it, and every release runs the export.

DotCharter.Tests.Services.Audio.LivePlay.why: Drives the live analyzer and the CQT verifier over synthesized audio end to end to check judged-hit timing; an end-to-end check of the live-play stack.
Scores live note detection over synthesized songs (accuracy percentages per riff, bass, harmonics, idle input); a slow accuracy corpus for the live-play stack.
Plays wall-clock synthetic performances through the live detection stack in the chunks the 30 Hz pump delivers; an end-to-end check of the live-play stack.
